verdict.rationale: Azure documents a dedicated Cost Management REST API that supports multidimensional queries, custom filters/expressions for consumption data, and budget/alert automation (azure-docs-22, azure-docs-30, azure-docs-14, azure-docs-13), which goes beyond a dashboard screenshot and is queryable programmatically. However, the evidence pack never explicitly describes scheduled/recurring cost exports or confirms resource-level (vs. subscription/resource-group) granularity in exports, so the story is only partially substantiated. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scheduled export configuration (e.g. daily/weekly export to storage) and confirmation of resource-level granularity in exported data, plus independent/hands-on corroboration that the API delivers this detail in practice.
